card.name: Just before a drug's name repeats
card.fires_on: Words in drug-label text where the next word is likely to be a drug name already mentioned, such as the middle of a drug name or a linking word before it. It also appears before a dose number.

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: Partway through a drug name such as macitentan, venlafaxine or fluoxetine, where the rest of the name is about to follow.
modes.example: within 7 days of discontinuing treatment with<< ven>>lafax

modes.label: Linking words before the drug
modes.description: Small words such as were, of or did in interaction sentences, just before the drug or an effect is stated.
modes.example: than when mycophenolic acid delayed-release tablets<< were>> administered alone under fasting conditions

card.plain: It fires in drug-interaction sentences, in the spot just before a drug name or dose is repeated.
